meta.purpose: Complete live-ready vehicle listing seed data with real media URLs
notes: This file is normalized for seeding: assetLibrary holds real media URLs, and listings reference those assets by key.
Seller refs must resolve to the existing verified partner or active prime customer records in resolvedUsers.
Only form-backed fields are included in each listing.

Fields such as variant, registrationYear, registrationNo, chassisOrSerialNo, previousOwners, fuelType, transmission, district, pinCode, nearbyLandmark, and insuranceExpiry are packed into the listing description during seed execution.
A single working walkaround video asset is reused across all listings.
Customer-created and partner-created listings will initially be created as PENDING_APPROVAL by the backend route, then optionally published after approval.
Resolved IDs are included so seed data mirrors the UI form flow and stores linked master-data references during execution.
